environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in isolated subnets (no NAT, no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0f4a8b7c2d1e9f3a6 interface endpoint (AWS PrivateLink). The VPC endpoint policy restricts principal to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root and source VPC vpc-0abc123def456. DNS is configured as a Route53 private hosted zone (pipeline.internal.corp) resolving to the ENI IPs of the VPC endpoint interface. No public DNS record exists. The Fargate task security group (sg-0x9f8e7d6c5b4a) only permits inbound TCP/8443 from the VPC endpoint's security group (sg-vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Subnet route tables have NO route to any internet gateway or NAT gateway - only local VPC CIDR route and the VPC endpoint route.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in subnet-isolated-a, subnet-isolated-b (no IGW, no NAT route)
config.dns: pipeline.internal.corp (Route53 private hosted zone, no public record)
config.route_table: rtb-isolated: 10.0.0.0/16 -> local (NO igw, NO nat, NO peering)
config.public_accessibility: none - no internet-routable path exists to service
